mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam (title, courseid, teacherid, description, content, duration, total_score, starttime, endtime, status, anti_cheat, createtime) VALUES (#{title}, #{courseid}, #{teacherid}, #{description}, #{content}, #{duration}, #{totalScore}, #{starttime}, #{endtime}, #{status}, #{antiCheat}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, c.coursename, t.teachername FROM exam e LEFT JOIN course c ON e.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON e.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE e.examid = #{examid}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam e LEFT JOIN course c ON e.courseid = c.courseid WHERE e.teacherid = #{teacherid}
AND (e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.coursename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT e.*, c.coursename, t.teachername, er.status AS record_status FROM exam e JOIN course c ON e.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON e.teacherid = t.teacherid JOIN courseclass cc ON cc.courseid = e.courseid JOIN student s ON s.classid = cc.classid LEFT JOIN exam_record er ON er.examid = e.examid AND er.studentid = s.studentid WHERE s.studentid = #{studentid} AND e.status = 1 ORDER BY e.examid DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record WHERE examid = #{examid} AND status >= 1
mapper.update: UPDATE exam SET status = #{status} WHERE examid = #{examid}
